mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM ds_chat_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_chat_session (id, tenant_id, user_id, connection_id, title, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{connectionId}, #{title}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM ds_chat_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_chat_message (id, tenant_id, session_id, user_id, role, parts_json, metadata_json, sequence, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{partsJson}, #{metadataJson}, #{sequence}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO ds_feedback_event (id, tenant_id, user_id, source, session_id, message_id, solved, reason_code, payload_json, free_text, recovery_action_taken, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{source}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{solved}, #{reasonCode}, #{payloadJson}, #{freeText}, #{recoveryActionTaken}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM ds_session_share WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_session_share (id, tenant_id, session_id, owner_user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_session_share SET expires_at = #{expiresAt}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND token_hash = #{tokenHash}
